answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk fakes: a new agent earns full rights only after eight trades with independent counterparties, logged in a crystal-clear record. A sybil farm trading only among its copies forms an island, so none reaches eight partners. An honest agent, like a knoll above flat ground, stands out with partners spread wide and pays one set of trades for undiluted rewards. Running 1,000 fakes needs 8,000 trades, each costing fees.
